extraction_method: AST-preserved registered decorators, full signatures and Pydantic model definitions evaluated locally with FastMCP 3.1.1 and Pydantic 2.11.7 (versions pinned in uv.lock), followed by in-process FastMCP Client.list_tools. Tool bodies replaced with pass only for schema extraction; news descriptions populated verbatim from AST docstrings. Full implementations inspected separately.
limitations: Source module imports, backend initialization, middleware and browser lifespan were bypassed during schema-only introspection to avoid unrelated dependencies and any network/browser side effects. No tool implementation was executed.

FastMCP and Pydantic match uv.lock; other transitive framework dependencies use available compatible versions. pyproject.toml permits newer FastMCP >=3/Pydantic >=2.11.7, whose future schema behavior may vary.
Runtime Google Trends geographic support and remote availability were not tested.
reason: All five unconditional registrations have complete locally generated caller input schemas, including one implemented Google Trends RSS trending tool.

tools.name: get_news_by_keyword
tools.description: Find articles by keyword using Google News.

period.description: Number of days to look back for articles.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return.

full_data.description: Return full data for each article. If False a summary should be created by setting the summarize flag

summarize.description: Generate a summary of the article, will first try LLM Sampling but if unavailable will use nlp

tools.behavior: Queries Google News through GNews.get_news, sets period in days and max_results, decodes RSS URLs and downloads publisher articles using newspaper4k with cloudscraper/Playwright fallback. Returns article fields according to full_data; summarize tries client LLM sampling then newspaper NLP fallback.
validation_notes: Pydantic Field enforces period >= 1 and 1 <= max_results <= 25 as represented in the schema; there is no period upper bound.
Search selector is a free string with no minLength or enum.

tools.name: get_trending_terms
tools.description: Returns google trends for a specific geo location.

geo.description:
Geographic target for trending terms. Supports four levels of granularity:
- Worldwide: empty string ''
- Country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. 'US', 'GB', 'CA'
- Subdivision (state/province/region): ISO 3166-2 format 'CC-XX' or 'CC-XXX', e.g. 'US-CA' (California), 'BE-BRU' (Brussels)
- US metro area: bare Nielsen DMA code (numeric string), e.g. '807' (San Francisco Bay Area), '501' (New York City)

full_data.description: Return full data for each trend including related news stories.

tools.behavior: Fetches current Google Trends trending terms via trendspy Trends.trending_now_by_rss(geo); sorts descending using int(volume[:-1]); returns keyword/volume only by default or richer trend objects with related news when full_data is true. Any fetch/sort exception is logged and returns an empty list.
validation_notes: geo is a free string: geographic examples in its description are not pattern/enum constraints. The wrapper performs no geo format validation; downstream trendspy behavior was not exercised.
